integrity: The induced-star characterization and standard exponential formula are credited as existing principles; the claimed contribution is their exact structural specialization, all-coefficient enumeration, and maximum-size multiplicity on L(K_n). Publication priority and independent validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact graph-polynomial theorem applies to triangular graphs L(K_n) (n>=0), not arbitrary line graphs or graphs in which every edge belongs to a triangle. Finite verification through n=8 and arithmetic comparisons through n=60 corroborate but do not prove the infinite theorem. Equivalent earlier enumeration under different terminology remains possible.
title: Edge-open-packing polynomial of triangular graphs via disjoint short paths
